items.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or addr/prefix network with a prefix of at least 1 (egress::parse_network, admin_tokens canonical_allowlist): octets 0 to 255 without leading zeros, prefix at most 32 (IPv4) or 128 (IPv6). The schema does not express that no host bits are set (10.0.0.1/8 answers 400), that IPv4-mapped IPv6 networks are refused (write them as IPv4; every spelling of ::ffff:a.b.c.d would need its own alternative), or that a duplicate after canonicalization answers 400 (1.2.3.4 and 1.2.3.4/32 are different strings, so uniqueItems accepts both). The prefix is parsed as a u8, so a plus sign and any number of leading zeros are accepted and the string has no length bound. The schema is stricter than the handler for IPv6 with an embedded dotted-quad tail: ::1.2.3.4 is accepted (stored as ::102:304/128) but the pattern refuses it. Entries are stored in canonical addr/len form.

purpose.description: OpenAI Files API purposes the gateway holds (filestore::Purpose::from_openai). fine-tune is refused as an unsupported capability (upload.rs store_purpose) and batch_output is not an upload purpose; both answer 400. batch input must be JSONL and vision files must be images (checked on the file's first bytes, which the schema cannot see: a batch file that is not JSONL or a vision file that is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image is accepted by the contract and answers 400); a purpose whose storage group is turned off in Settings answers 403.

expires_after[anchor].description: Only created_at is accepted; any other anchor answers 400.

expires_after[seconds].description: Integer seconds, 3600 through 2592000 (1 hour to 30 days); supply with expires_after[anchor]. The handler trims surrounding whitespace before parsing (upload.rs Fields::validate: s.trim().parse::<i64>()), so surrounding Unicode whitespace (for example a no-break space), a leading plus and leading zeros are accepted; the field is at most 64 bytes (FormReader::text), which maxLength can only approximate in characters. The pattern's \s equals Rust's trim except U+FEFF (ECMA-262 whitespace, not trimmed by Rust) and U+0085 (trimmed by Rust, not ECMA \s); so a value padded with U+0085 is refused by the contract although the handler accepts it, and one padded with U+FEFF is accepted by the contract although the handler refuses it.

post_api_v1_workspaces_by_ws_files_uploa.description: Streamed multipart parts. purpose and expiry fields may precede/follow file; no unknown or duplicate fields. The file part is binary, nonempty; server-controlled byte cap and quota apply.

name.description: At most 120 UTF-8 BYTES, at least one non-whitespace character, no control characters (management valid_name: s.len() <= 120). maxLength counts characters, so it is necessary but not sufficient: a name of fewer than 120 characters is still refused when its multibyte characters exceed 120 bytes.

S6MoneyInput.description: Canonical positive integer micro-USD string, 1 to 9223372036854775807 (an i64: governance::money parses it as i64 and refuses zero for budgets, so 19-digit values above the i64 maximum and "0" answer 400). The first member is the canonical integer form; the second bounds it to a positive i64. The schema is stricter than the handler on one point: governance::money accepts leading zeros up to 19 characters ("007" is 7), which the canonical pattern refuses.

S6KeyLayerLimits.description: Limits of one key lineage layer: a key has no storage or issuance quota (always null).

S6KnownBudgetWindow.description: A visible budget window whose accounting is exact: no request of the window has an unknown cost, so the remaining allowance is known (governance::totals BudgetReport::remaining). The report is valid only when unknown_cost_requests (unknown + unresolved - unresolved_unknown + unreserved executions) is 0 exactly when all three counters are 0 (read_budget_report's validity check, totals.rs:158-162), which fixes unresolved_usage to false and, because held_unknown_microusd must be 0 whenever unknown is 0, unknown_held_microusd to "0"; used_microusd is then settled plus pending held.

S6UnknownCostBudgetWindow.description: A visible budget window with at least one request whose cost is unknown: usage is a lower bound and no remaining allowance is computed (policies.rs budget_windows: headroom_status unknown, remaining_microusd null).

S6UnavailableBudgetWindow.description: A visible budget window whose maintained totals row fails its consistency validation (read_budget_report returns None): no accounting figure is fabricated, every one is null and the headroom is unknown.
